story.title: Why I left the office to work in your garden.
paragraphs: I grew up on a farm in Tasmania, Australia, where working outdoors was just part of life. After school I studied economics, then spent years working in accounting and sales. I was decent at it, but at the end of a long day all I had to show for it was a spreadsheet I'd spent six hours building.

Gardening was always the thing I came back to. Six hours in a garden and you can completely transform the way someone feels about their outdoor space. Same amount of time as a day at the desk, completely different level of satisfaction. I'd been thinking about starting a garden maintenance business for over five years before I finally made the leap.

When I moved to Cornwall in 2025, it felt like the right time. I settled near Newquay and the landscapes here convinced me I'd made the right call. Mild winters that keep things growing almost year-round, rugged coastline, and communities that genuinely value their outdoor spaces. I started Quilliams Gardening & Landscaping and haven't looked back.

Cornwall's climate brings its own challenges that I've learned to work with. Salt-laden winds near the coast mean choosing hardy, wind-tolerant plants. The mild, wet winters keep lawns growing well into November but also encourage moss and weed growth. Clay-heavy soils in areas like Truro need proper drainage, while the sandy soils closer to the coast drain almost too well. Every garden here has its own character, and that's what makes the work interesting.

goal.title: The goal
goal.description: Everything I do is built around the experience you get, from the first message to the final blow-down. I'm not the cheapest gardener in Cornwall, but I think you'll notice the difference. My favourite jobs are the big messy clearances. They have the biggest visual impact, make the biggest difference to the customer, and I can justify skipping the gym that day.

faq.title: Common questions about hiring a gardener in Cornwall.
faq.description: If your question isn't answered here, send me a message through the quote form or call me on 07593 121 621.

items.question: Do you only do ongoing maintenance?
items.answer: Not at all. I do both ongoing garden maintenance and one-off cleanups or transformations. Most of my regular clients started with a one-off job and liked the result enough to book me monthly. We'll figure out what makes sense for your space.

items.question: Can I get a quote without a site visit?
items.answer: Usually, yes. A short description and a few photos are enough for most quotes. I'll send you a clear price within 24 hours. For bigger jobs like full landscaping projects, I may pop round for a quick look first, free of charge.

items.question: What areas do you cover?
items.answer: I'm based in Trevarrian near Newquay and cover most of Cornwall including Truro, St Austell, Bodmin, Padstow, Perranporth, and St Ives. If you're unsure whether I cover your area, just ask. I'm usually happy to travel.

items.question: Do you take away green waste?
items.answer: Yes, I'm a licensed waste carrier so I can handle green waste removal properly. It's included in most quotes, but I'll always confirm upfront whether removal is included or if there's a small additional charge for larger loads.

items.question: How do I book?
items.answer: The quickest way is the quote form. Send a few photos and a description and I'll get back to you within 24 hours. You can also call me on 07593 121 621 or send a message through WhatsApp. I usually have availability within the same week.
